answer: Rule: every identity locks 500 POA as operating stake before it can act in the lagoon, and its action rate is capped by its own stake, never by the operator total. One operator splitting 5,000 POA across 50 identities gets 50 weak ones, each capped at 1/50 of full rate, so total influence never exceeds the stake held. A fake identity costs 500 POA locked plus lost yield, and the cost scales linearly: N fakes need N x 500 POA. Even copies minted in sable secrecy pay the same lock, and the haven of free identities is closed: sybil power is bought only with real capital.
